        exit 1
    fi
    MODEL="$ACTUAL_PATH"
    echo "Model downloaded to: $MODEL"
else

    NESTED=$(find "$MODEL" -name "config.json" -type f | head -1 | xargs dirname 2>/dev/null)

        MODEL="$NESTED"
    fi

    echo "Please wait for it to finish or manually stop it before running this script."
    exit 1
fi

# Start vLLM
echo "=== [$(date)] Starting vLLM (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) on port $PORT ==="
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model "$MODEL" \
    --max-model-len 8192 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
    --port $PORT \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --dtype auto > /tmp/vllm_exp004.log 2>&1 &

echo "vLLM PID: $VLLM_PID"

        tail -20 /tmp/vllm_exp004.log
        exit 1

if ! curl -s http://localhost:$PORT/v1/models > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: vLLM did not start within 180s"
    kill $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null
    exit 1
fi

    --k 12 \
    --temperature 0.7 \
    --max-tokens 4096 \
    --api-base "http://localhost:$PORT/v1" \

    --save-intermediates \
    --seed 42

echo "=== [$(date)] Stopping vLLM ==="
kill $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
echo "EXP004_DONE"
